versions.changelog:
- Initial release of fix-broken-links.
- Scans HTML, Markdown, JS/TS, JSON, CSS, SQL, and template files for broken links and generic SEO anchor text.
- Interactive repair menu: replace, custom URL, strip link, or skip.
- Offers agent-suggested replacements via GitHub Copilot CLI if available.
- Flags weak anchor text like "click here" for SEO improvements.
- Includes both Bash and PowerShell scripts for cross-platform support.
